problem: Generic time foundations currently include business-calendar under ISO 8601/OWL-Time/RFC3339/Lamport evidence, but working-day/holiday/shift rules are domain or jurisdiction policy, not universal temporal semantics.
proposed_resolution: Keep instant/interval/duration/timezone and generic recurrence primitives in time foundations; move BusinessCalendarPolicy to an explicit imported policy contract keyed by jurisdiction/enterprise/calendar edition. Generic recurrence may use RFC 5545 semantics but never invent business-day rules.

problem: money-core is grouped under physical quantity evidence (SI/VIM/GUM), which cannot supply currency identity, minor-unit, valuation, legal-tender or accounting semantics.
proposed_resolution: Retain a minimal MonetaryAmount carrier only if it imports an edition-pinned CurrencyRef and exact decimal/minor-unit policy. Currency identity imports ISO 4217 registry; valuation, exchange rate, legal-tender and accounting policies remain separate bounded authorities.

problem: probability-core currently inherits measurement/quantity sources. Probability is mathematical/statistical semantics and must not inherit physical measurement authority merely because values are numeric.
proposed_resolution: Re-home probability distribution/event/measure semantics into mathematical/statistical foundations; measurement uncertainty may import probability semantics but does not own them.
required_research: separate probability measure from empirical frequency and measurement uncertainty

problem: verification-receipt is currently in the intent family, but a verification result is epistemic evidence about a subject/requirement and must not be owned by intent semantics.
proposed_resolution: Move generic VerificationReceipt identity/status/evidence-cut semantics to evidence/assurance foundations. Intent may reference acceptance predicates and required verification kinds but cannot mint verification evidence.

problem: Platform Commercial & Support currently owns tenant identity and platform account identity while upstream boundary research separately identifies Platform Estate & Tenancy Administration as a strong horizontal product. Tenant/account estate identity is administrative platform control, not commercial lifecycle meaning.
proposed_resolution: Re-home tenant registry/hierarchy and platform account identity to Platform Estate & Tenancy Administration / platform-control semantics. Commercial/support may import TenantRef/AccountRef but cannot issue or define them.

problem: Commercial customer party identity risks becoming a second master/party identity authority rather than a scoped commercial role over an upstream party/legal-entity identity.
proposed_resolution: Commercial support owns CommercialCustomer/PartyRole bindings and editions, but imports stable PartyRef and ExternalLegalEntityRef from the appropriate master/legal-entity authorities; role binding never changes upstream party identity.

problem: One lineage/provenance/evidence family cannot use OpenLineage as semantic authority for provenance propositions, authenticated attestations, verification, appraisal and acceptance.
proposed_resolution: Use W3C PROV for provenance propositions/relations/bundles; OpenLineage for observed Job/Run/Dataset operational lineage events; in-toto for authenticated artifact claims; keep verification/appraisal/acceptance as separate assurance authorities. A claim can move through these layers only via explicit typed transformations and receipts.

problem: Concept/terminology, formal ontology, metadata registry, catalog, mapping, code/value-set and master-record lifecycles are different semantic authorities and must not collapse under one metadata/ontology owner.
proposed_resolution: Route concept schemes/mappings to SKOS; formal ontology semantics to OWL/profile owners; metadata-registry concepts/representations to ISO/IEC 11179; catalogs/datasets/distributions/services to DCAT; keep code systems/value sets, master records and certification as separate lifecycle owners/imports.

problem: WCAG/ARIA establish accessibility semantics, not visualization grammar, semantic query, metrics, disclosure or application decision authority.
proposed_resolution: Separate presentation/visual encoding grammar, accessibility semantics, semantic query/metric contracts, disclosure policy and interaction/runtime state. Visualization may transform presentation data only under declared loss/aggregation rules and cannot mint metric or business meaning.
